search_text: published ZDI-22-075 ZDI-CAN-14539 NetBSD Kernel stat System Call Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2022-01-14 5.5 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['NetBSD'] ['Kernel'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NetBSD Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the stat system call. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. title: NetBSD Kernel stat System Call Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NetBSD Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the stat system call. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel.
